mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 9.0% over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE has been above 9.0% for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 200), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) signals supply chain constraints that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 and CPIAUCSL > 200, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has been above 2.0% for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Higher levels of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) consistently support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of the absolute level of employment.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is above the 50th percentile, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% for two consecutive quarters), strong consumer spending (RSAFS growth > 1.0% month-over-month) accelerates demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% for two consecutive quarters)
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth > 1.0% and GDPC1 growth > 2.0% for two consecutive quarters, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) and a rise in housing starts (HOUST above 600.0) signals conflicting supply and demand pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 and HOUST > 600.0, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.
